chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who doubts after he has finished his prayer, he said: 'He does not repeat (the prayer), and there is nothing upon him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who doubts their prayer after finishing it?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of 'certainty is not removed by doubt' (istishab al-hal) in the context of post-prayer uncertainty, distinguishing it from doubt arising during the prayer itself. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential preference for ease (taysir) and the stability of the original state, ensuring that minor doubts do not invalidate the completed act of worship.
